start_command: npm run build && node tools/eva-reset-fixture.mjs && npm start
seed_command: none (offline PIN accounts; register fully offline; no secrets required)
reset_command: remove disposable account/state data under the data root and restart
cleanup: rm -rf .eva-tmp/family-castle-clash && remove any fixture accounts (eva-fixture) created during the run
prohibited_actions: NO private family photos, recordings, or real private assets — synthetic cards only
keep the private-assets directory out of the QA instance entirely
never register accounts using real family member names — synthetic fixture usernames only

coverage.unautomated_reason: requires a second connected socket peer; single-instance QA cannot form a lobby pairing yet
needs a persisted account with unlocked cards; deferred until an authenticated fixture session is wired
battle renders to a canvas over Socket.io — no DOM to assert against; must be verified via server state/text, not canvas pixels; full battle sim unautomated

journeys.name: Login screen loads and identifies Castle Clash
journeys.user_impact: If the login screen does not load, no family member can play at all.

journeys.name: A new offline PIN account can register and reach the home mode select
journeys.user_impact: If offline registration fails, a new player can never create an account (registration is fully offline by design).
